files.description: Main EHI export documentation PDF (9 pages). Index page linking to three sub-documents, plus all three sub-documents inline. Contains step-by-step screenshot walkthroughs for exporting C-CDA documents via single patient, multiple patients, and patient portal paths.

Single patient C-CDA export walkthrough (3 pages). Step-by-step screenshots showing: Lookup Medical Records → search patient → Clinical Document → Summary of Care Records → generate CCDA → download ZIP.

Multiple patient C-CDA export walkthrough (2 pages). Step-by-step screenshots showing: EMR Reports → Export Patient Medical Records → select patients → generate ZIP. Shows a system with 12,217 patients.
Patient portal C-CDA export walkthrough (3 pages). Step-by-step screenshots showing: Patient Portal login → View Health Information → Summary of Care Records → download ZIP.
